decisions.series: Single complete #1-396 base checklist; all numbered subjects equally weighted.
decisions.variants: Collapse TCDB a/b/c copyright-line variations to one collectible per card number; conflicting card identities block import.
decisions.rookies: Use TCDB rookie index, deduplicated by printed card number; expected 60 unique true Base RCs; append RC only in Base.
decisions.glossy: 11-card Glossy NFL Stars set originated 1 per 45-card rack pack. With 15-card wax equivalent, VCS models approximately 1:3 packs.
decisions.superPlay: 27 team/play Super Play Game Cards are pack-issued related collectibles; numeric insertion odds not source-verified, so oddsPerPack null. Do not invent rates.
decisions.mailIns: Exclude 1984 NFL Football Stars Collector's Edition glossy mail-ins.
decisions.pack: VCS four cards per pack, 24 packs per box; original physical wax had 15 cards.
decisions.release: Remain unreleased pending checklist/import verification, review of Super Play Game Card distribution, pricing, scans, pack artwork and QA.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: One 396-card checklist; copyright printing variations collapsed.

productSets.name: Super Play Game Cards
productSets.notes: TCDB recognizes 27 pack-related game cards; no documented compatible pack odds. Draft only; release requires distribution QA.
